_what: Frozen counts for check:unreachable. It may only go DOWN.
_why: Server functions and components with no importer are pre-existing debt nobody in flight wrote. Failing every lane on it is how a check gets reverted rather than fixed, so this freezes the number and fails only on an INCREASE. Lower these when you land a fix; the check tells you the new number.
_components_dropped_from_80: The detector could not see React.lazy. Every lazily mounted panel is written as import("...").then((m) => ({ default: m.Name })), which names its export and was still invisible, so 26 mounted components were reported as orphans. The count is 44 because the gate got better, not because 26 things were deleted. Anyone comparing against 80 is comparing across a change in the instrument.
_names: The SORTED `file::name` of every orphan at the frozen counts. Added 2026-09-01 because the ratchet fired -- server functions 140 -> 142, components 44 -> 45 -- and named nothing, so the lane that caused it would have had to re-derive a 142-entry list by hand and diff it against a number. The counts say THAT something regressed; these say WHAT. Re-freeze both together or the gate reports a name list one state behind, which is worse than none.
_namesFrozenAt: cda1276fa959cdeae05fafffc3c22d551b76510c, the commit that set 140/44. Measured by running the detector of THAT commit against the src/ tree of that commit, not by trimming today's list, so the two sides of the comparison are the same instrument.
_components_dropped_from_44: A second change of instrument, 2026-09-01. The component half asked 'does another FILE import this', which is right for a server function and wrong for a component: S1 traced ReleaseDocument and AssembledRelease and both are reached by a person opening /ship, exported only so their test can render them. 17 of 45 rows were in that class. They are now printed separately and not counted, so 44 became 27 at THIS SAME COMMIT because the gate got better, not because anything was deleted. Anyone comparing against 44, or against the 80 above, is comparing across a change in the instrument.
_notes: A reason attached to an orphan by name, printed beside its row. It does NOT excuse it and does NOT change the count -- that is the one fix this gate forbids. It exists because S2 asked for getLineageCounts to be marked 'staged ahead of a surface' so a later lane scanning the list would not read it as dead weight and delete it. That risk is real and the answer to it is a note on the row, not removal from the number: removing it would also remove the pressure that gets it wired. The gate's own text already says an orphan is one of three things; this says WHICH, for the ones somebody has actually determined.

notes.src/lib/lineage-graph.functions.ts::getL: WIRED ON lane/control, NOT YET ON MAIN -- verified 2026-09-01, not taken on report: three importers on origin/lane/control (today/Board.tsx, today/CameFrom.tsx, today/lineage-line.ts) plus a test named a-count-we-could-not-read-is-not-zero, and ZERO importers on origin/main. So this row is CORRECT about main and clears when lane/control merges. It was 'staged ahead of a surface' for one day: S2 stopped at the clickable half of the lineage line for a performance reason S4 showed did not exist (AuditTag does not fetch at all), so the open item was never speed, it was the missing line -- and S2 then built it.

_instrumentWhat: Which version of the detector produced these counts. 1: original. 2: React.lazy imports made visible (components 80 -> 44). 3: internally-rendered exports separated from orphans (44 -> 27, same commit). The gate REFUSES to print IMPROVED or Holding when this does not match its own INSTRUMENT constant, because a delta across a rule change is not a delta. Bump both together and re-freeze in the same commit.
_lastBanked: components 27 -> 26 on 2026-09-01, banked only after reading WHY. The one that left is AskInPlace -- S3's 176-line component with zero mounts -- now wired. NOT the two icons: they were never in this baseline's names, because it was measured at cda1276fa before they became orphans, so their deletion nets to zero here. serverFunctions is deliberately NOT lowered and the gate stays RED: its single newcomer is getLineageCounts, whose wiring is on lane/control and not yet on main. Banking a fix that has not merged is the same error as banking a deletion that has not merged.
